d: Two figures are depicted: the taller figure has short, straight aqua-blue hair with a side-swept fringe and closed eyes, appearing as a mature adult with a slender build, wearing a white and gold high-collared robe; the shorter figure has short, straight rose-pink hair with a blunt fringe and closed eyes, appearing as a youth with a petite build, wearing a white and gold sleeveless dress with a flared skirt adorned with gold stars. Both figures feature golden wing-like ornaments extending from their heads. The shorter figure is enveloped by large, flowing golden ribbons that spiral downward. BODY COLOR: Pale ivory LEGS: Plantigrade, wearing white stockings.
